---
title: "Table Data"
---

The `table` block contains the actual table data, split into `thead` and `tbody`.

## Structure

```json
{
  "table": {
    "thead": { "rows": [...] },
    "tbody": [
      { "rows": [...] },
      { "rows": [...] }
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- ir-fields: TableBlock -->

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `thead` | TableHead | required | The column labels |
| `tbody` | array of RowGroup | required | The body, as row groups ([below](#tbody-row-groups)) |

## thead

```json
{
  "thead": {
    "rows": [{
      "role": "column_label",
      "style_id": null,
      "cells": [{
        "content": [{ "type": "text", "value": "Name" }],
        "colspan": 1, "rowspan": 1,
        "style_id": null,
        "is_stub": false, "is_placeholder": false,
        "scope": "col"
      }]
    }]
  }
}
```

<!-- ir-fields: TableHead -->

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `rows` | array of [Row](#row-fields) | required | `config.header_rows` rows: spanner labels above the column labels |

## tbody (Row Groups)

The body is an array of row groups. Each group has an optional label, data rows, and
optional summary rows. A table without groups puts its rows in one group with no label.

```json
{
  "tbody": [{
    "group_id": "grp_1",
    "label": {
      "content": [{ "type": "text", "value": "North America" }],
      "style_id": null
    },
    "rows": [{ "role": null, "cells": [...] }],
    "summary_rows": []
  }]
}
```

<!-- ir-fields: RowGroup -->

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `group_id` | string? | `null` | The group's id; HTML makes element ids from it (else from the label) |
| `label` | GroupLabel? | `null` | A line above the group's rows, across the table |
| `rows` | array of [Row](#row-fields) | required | The data rows |
| `summary_rows` | array of [Row](#row-fields) | `[]` | Summary rows, below the data rows (they need a stub column, `SUMMARY_REQUIRES_STUB`) |

### Group labels

<!-- ir-fields: GroupLabel -->

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `content` | array of [content nodes](index.qmd#content-nodes) | required | The label |
| `style_id` | string? | `null` | The label's style |
| `colspan` | integer? | `null` | Kept for producers, but not read: a group label always spans the whole (visible) table |

## Row Fields

<!-- ir-fields: Row -->

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `cells` | array of [Cell](#cell-fields) | required | Exactly `config.table_cols` cells, placeholders included |
| `role` | keyword? | `null` | `"column_label"` or `"spanner_label"` in `thead`; `"summary_row"` or `"grand_summary_row"` in a group's `summary_rows`; `null` for a data row |
| `style_id` | string? | `null` | A style for the whole row |

## Cell Fields

<!-- ir-fields: Cell -->

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `content` | array of [content nodes](index.qmd#content-nodes) | required | What the cell shows (empty for a placeholder) |
| `typed_value` | TypedValue? | `null` | The value behind the display ([below](#typed-values)) |
| `colspan` | integer | `1` | Columns the cell spans (≥ 1) |
| `rowspan` | integer | `1` | Rows the cell spans (≥ 1), within its section |
| `style_id` | string? | `null` | The cell's style |
| `is_stub` | boolean | `false` | The cell is a row label, in a stub column |
| `is_placeholder` | boolean | `false` | The cell is a position another cell spans ([below](#spans-and-placeholders)) |
| `scope` | keyword? | `null` | HTML: what a header cell labels, `"col"`, `"row"`, `"colgroup"` or `"rowgroup"` |
| `sort_key` | any? | `null` | A value to sort the row by, for producers and tools. No writer reads it |
| `data_type` | keyword? | `null` | The value's type, as in `typed_value.type`. No writer reads it |

## Typed Values

`typed_value` is the value behind a cell's display, `{"type": …, "value": …}`.

<!-- ir-fields: TypedValue -->

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `type` | keyword | required | `"string"`, `"number"`, `"integer"`, `"boolean"`, `"date"`, `"datetime"`, `"time"` or `"duration"` (aliases in [Keyword values](validation.qmd#keyword-values)) |
| `value` | any | required | The value |

Writers that keep values (XLSX) read `value` as:

| `type`                 | `value`                                             |
|------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| `number`, `integer`    | a JSON number                                       |
| `boolean`              | `true` or `false`                                   |
| `date`                 | an ISO 8601 date string: `"2024-03-15"`             |
| `datetime`             | `"2024-03-15T14:30:00"` (or a space for the `T`; seconds and their fraction optional; no offset) |
| `time`                 | `"14:30:00"` (seconds and their fraction optional)  |

The value is what the cell holds; `content` is still what it shows. A value in
another form is kept as text.

```json
{ "content": [{"type": "text", "value": "Mar 15, 2024"}],
  "typed_value": {"type": "date", "value": "2024-03-15"} }
```

## Spans and Placeholders

Cells with `colspan` or `rowspan` > 1 span multiple positions. Spanned-over positions
**must** contain placeholder cells:

```json
[
  { "content": [{"type": "text", "value": "Wide"}], "colspan": 2 },
  { "content": [], "is_placeholder": true }
]
```

::: {.callout-warning}
Placeholder cells must have **empty** `content`. The validator rejects non-empty placeholders.
:::
